verdict.rationale: SendGrid publishes a structured v3 API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g., POST /v3/mail/send, regional base URLs) and copy-paste sample code in multiple languages and cURL. Sandbox mode lets those examples be run as validation-only requests without delivering mail. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive, in-browser 'try it' console. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser explorer that executes requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.
